seasonHistoryMethodology: Three most recent completed club seasons available as at 20 August 2026. Domestic-league appearances and goals are used unless the league field explicitly identifies an academy or cup competition. Calendar-year leagues use completed 2023-2025 seasons; multiple clubs in one season are combined. Starts, minutes and assists are null when the reviewed source did not publish them, and youth-only records remain null when no reliable seasonal total was found.
avatarMethodology: One traceable public image source per player, prioritising official club profiles and clean player portraits. External images are marked prototype-only unless reuse rights are stated on the source page. Signing, editorial and generic squad-page images are flagged for manual identity/crop review before production use.

positionMetricFramework.seasonScope: Each player's latest completed-season record in this file. Advanced provider data is limited to the competition named in advancedDataScope; split-club and academy seasons may therefore be partial.

comparisonRules.totals: Use totals for availability and cumulative output.
comparisonRules.rates: Use per-90 rates for stylistic comparison, but only treat them as comparison-ready from 450 minutes.
comparisonRules.context: Compare within a similar position, competition strength, team style and sample size; raw counts are not a universal player rating.
comparisonRules.missingValues: null means the public source did not expose a reliable figure for that player-season; it does not mean zero.
comparisonRules.sourceConflicts: Provider samples are preserved in sourceSample when they differ from the existing season summary rather than silently overwriting the three-season history.

transferResearchMethodology.scope: Current club, league, loan/parent-club status, completed transfers and the newest material transfer reports were checked for all 89 listed players.
rules: Completed transfers and official loan announcements update the current club fields.
Expired loans revert to the parent club unless a new move is confirmed.
Transfer interest, talks and bids are recorded as rumours and do not change the current club.
Historical seasonHistory and lastCompletedSeason records are preserved even when the player changes club afterward.
For academy and lower-profile players, an official club, competition, match or established data-provider record may be used where no transfer announcement is indexed.

seniorStatusMethodology.scope: Republic of Ireland men senior team only; youth caps excluded; friendlies excluded from competitiveSeniorStarts.
seniorStatusMethodology.nullPolicy: Unknown or insufficiently sourced values are null. Zero is used only when a source supports a genuine zero.
seniorStatusMethodology.careerInternationalSourceNote: National Football Teams player records were used for career caps/starts where current and internally consistent; FAI line-ups were used to extend records through June 2026 when needed.
seniorStatusMethodology.dateConflictPolicy: The official FAI review date of 2026-06-06 is used for the Canada match; some third-party records list 2026-06-05.
seniorStatusMethodology.legacyCapsField: Reconciled to verified seniorCaps. It is null when a senior total could not be verified, preventing youth caps or assumed zeroes from feeding senior-status rules.
